meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构改进点，生成可视化报告并逐项审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望系统化发现并改进代码库的架构问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically find and fix architecture issues in your codebase

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你的代码库，找出架构上可以改进的地方，生成一份可视化的 HTML 报告，然后和你一起深入讨论你选中的改进项。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 分析代码库架构、寻找重构机会时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个项目的架构，找出可以改进的地方。
say.note: Claude 会生成 HTML 报告并打开。

say.text: 分析代码库，找出哪些模块太浅、需要加深。
say.note: Claude 会应用“删除测试”来识别浅层模块。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase for architectural improvements, generates a visual HTML report, and then discusses each candidate you pick in depth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze codebase architecture and find refactoring opportunities.

say_en.text: Scan this project's architecture and find improvements.
say_en.note: Claude generates an HTML report and opens it.

say_en.text: Analyze the codebase for shallow modules that need deepening.
say_en.note: Claude applies the deletion test to identify shallow modules.
